page.overview:
Who is Tiger Jackson?

Tiger is a mysterious man who entered the "The King of Iron Fist Tournament" dressed in clothes inspired by the golden ages of soul and disco music. His polished capoeira moves look quite similar to those used by Eddy Gordo, but the nature of the relationship between these two fighters remains a mystery.

Though Tiger never speaks, he is depicted in the games as fun-loving and carefree, dancing in his intros, outros, and Arcade Mode endings.

Tiger is a dark-skinned man whose hair in each of his appearances is always styled in an afro. In his Tekken Tag Tournament render, his eyes are shown to be brown. In Tekken 3 and Tekken Tag Tournament, Tiger has full sideburns with a moustache, while in his Tekken Tag Tournament 2 appearance, his sideburns are paired with a neatly-trimmed goatee.

Tiger does not have an official storyline within Tekken 3.
